Business Development Representative Job at Ibifoundry Limited




        
    

        
        Ibifoundry Limited is a business services and digital strategy firm. The company specializes in several key professional areas: Business Systems: Designing and implementing structured operational frameworks for organizations, Digital Strategy: Developing online growth and marketing plans to enhance brand presence. Enterprise-Level Growth: Providing expert guidance on scaling businesses and improving overall enterprise performance.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Business Development Representative

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

            
    




	We are looking for a Business Development Representative to act as the liaison between our Marketing and Sales teams.
	Your role will be to seek new business opportunities by contacting and developing relationships with potential customers.


Responsibilities


	Contact potential clients through cold calls and emails
	Present our company to potential clients
	Identify client needs and suggest appropriate products/services
	Customize product solutions to increase customer satisfaction
	Build long-term trusting relationships with clients
	Proactively seek new business opportunities in the market
	Set up meetings or calls between (prospective) clients and Account Executives
	Report to the Business Development Manager on (weekly/monthly/quarterly) sales results.


Skills:


	Basic knowledge with CRM software (e.g. Salesforce)
	Familiarity with MS Excel (analyzing spreadsheets and charts)
	Understanding of sales performance metrics
	communication and negotiation skills.


Salary
N150,000 - N350,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Human Resources Officer Job at  Chabash Development and Health Initiative (CDHI)




        
    

        
        The Chabash Development and Health Initiative (CDHI) is a women-led national NGO registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC/IT/NO 85190) and operational across Northeast and Northwest Nigeria. CDHI’s mission is to empower individuals and communities to live healthy, productive lives through integrated interventions in health, nutrition, protection, WASH, and livelihoods. CDHI partners with international organizations and government agencies to deliver sustainable and community-driven solutions that strengthen local systems and promote equity.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Human Resources Officer
     

            
    



Job Location: Maiduguri, Borno
Reports to: Head of Operations
Supervises: Human Resource Assistant

Job Summary


	The Human Resources Officer is responsible for implementing HR policies, managing employee relations, supporting recruitment, and ensuring compliance with labour laws and donor regulations.
	The position supports staff recruitment, onboarding, performance management, training, and HR record management, contributing to a positive, productive, and compliant work environment at CDHI.


Key Responsibilities
 Recruitment & Staffing: 


	Lead end-to-end recruitment processes — job posting, shortlisting, interviewing, and onboarding — prepare employment contracts and offer letters, and maintain accurate, up-to-date job descriptions across all positions.


HR Administration & Record Management: 


	Maintain accurate and confidential staff records, including employment history, leave, training, and performance evaluations, and support processing of payroll by providing accurate HR data to the finance unit.


Employee Relations & Welfare:


	 Serve as the first point of contact for HR-related inquiries and staff concerns, promote a healthy and respectful workplace culture, support staff welfare and benefits administration, and address employee grievances professionally.


Performance Management & Capacity Building: 


	Support implementation of performance appraisal systems, guide supervisors and staff on performance improvement processes, and identify training needs to inform annual capacity-building plans.


Compliance & Policy Implementation:


	 Ensure HR policies are implemented consistently and updated in line with Nigerian labor laws and donor standards, and support internal and external audits with HR-related documentation and responses.


Safeguarding & Accountability: 


	Ensure staff compliance with CDHI’s Code of Conduct, Safeguarding, and Child Protection Policies, and promote a workplace culture that prevents exploitation, abuse, and harassment.


Qualifications and Experience
Education: 


	Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, Social Sciences, or a related field (CIPM certification is an advantage).


Experience:


	Minimum of 3–5 years of relevant HR experience, preferably in an NGO or donor-funded organization.


Technical Knowledge:


	Good knowledge of Nigerian labor laws, HR best practices, and recruitment procedures, with experience managing staff benefits, contracts, and performance systems.


Skills:


	Strong interpersonal Communication and conflict resolution skills.
	A high level of confidentiality Integrity.
	 Professionalism and excellent computer skills, especially MS Excel and HR software/tools.


Language & Context:
Fluency in English: 


	knowledge of local languages (Hausa, Kanuri, Fulfulde) is an added advantage. Willingness to travel occasionally to field offices and project sites.


Core Competencies:


	Confidentiality and ethical conduct.
	Staff relationship management and conflict resolution.
	Organizational and multitasking abilities.
	Gender sensitivity and inclusion mindset.
	Accountability and teamwork, with strong documentation and reporting skills.


Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA):


	Actively promote PSEA standards within CDHI and amongst beneficiaries served by the organization, ensuring zero tolerance for sexual exploitation, abuse, and harassment.
	Perform any other duties that may be assigned from time to time by supervisors.


Compliance & Ethics:


	Promote and encourage a culture of compliance and ethics throughout CDHI.
	Maintain a clear understanding of CDHI’s and donor compliance and ethics standards as applicable to the position, and adhere to those standards.
	Conduct all work with the highest level of integrity.

Head of Finance job at Pruvia Integrated Limited




        
    

        
        Pruvia Integrated Limited -  We are a general service merchant with a strong desire to ensure customer satisfaction in the midst of efficient and effective service delivery. As an organization, we are driven by the dictum of ‘Impossibility is Nothing’.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Head of Finance

Job Location: Ogudu, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are looking for a highly competent and commercially aware Head of Finance to lead the financial management of our real estate business.
	The ideal candidate will oversee all financial operations, ensure regulatory compliance, drive cost control, and provide management with accurate, timely financial insight to support business growth and investment decisions.


Key Responsibilities


	Oversee all day-to-day financial operations.
	Prepare accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and management accounts.
	Develop and monitor financial KPIs, dashboards, and variance reports for executive review.
	Manage cash flow, liquidity planning, and fund allocation across active development projects and operations.
	Lead the annual budgeting process and mid-year financial reviews across all business units.
	Provide financial modelling, investment appraisals, and cost-benefit analyses for projects.
	Oversee statutory filings.
	Partner with the operations and sales teams.


Requirements


	5 – 7 years of progressive finance or accounting experience with at least 3 years in a senior finance management role.
	Professional qualification is required.
	Proficiency in accounting software (QuickBooks, Sage, or ERP platforms) and advanced Microsoft Excel.
	B.Sc. / HND in Accounting, Finance, or Economics. An MBA is an advantage.


Salary
N450,000 / month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Head of Finance" as the subject of the email.
